description:
Please Note - No comments can be taken into account.

This is not a planning application it is a request for a Screening Opinion only.

A Screening Opinion is not an opportunity for the Local Planning Authority (LPA) to provide comments or feedback on the acceptability or not of any future proposals for this site, and is a purely technical assessment to determine whether, in the opinion of the LPA, the development described would constitute EIA development, requiring an Environmental Statement to be submitted alongside any future planning application.

If a planning application is submitted in the future, then that application would go through the normal notification procedures which would include letters to neighbouring properties, site notices, and press notices in a local newspaper, and at that stage, the Local Planning Authority would be able to consider materially relevant objections from interested parties, including members of the public.

Current Request - Request for Screening Opinion under the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 in relation to an outline planning application for a residential-led development of up to 570 dwellings.
